question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

He is __reluctant__ to do the work.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"reluctant"** means unwilling or hesitant to do something. (अनिच्छुक)

 
 
• **Example: **She was reluctant to share her personal information with strangers.
 
 
 
• **"Hesitant" **refers to being unsure or slow in acting or speaking due to uncertainty. (हिचकिचाहट वाला)
 
 
• **Example: **He was hesitant to ask for help because he didn't want to appear weak.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'reluctant' **is **'hesitant'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Happy **(खुश): Feeling or showing pleasure or contentment.

 
 
• **Example:** She was happy to see her old friends at the reunion.
 
 
 
• **Disposed **(उदासीन): Inclined or willing to do something.
 
 
• **Example: **He was disposed to help his neighbors during the difficult times.
 
 
 
• **Eager** (उत्सुक): Strongly wanting to do or have something.
 
 
• **Example:** The students were eager to start their new project.

The correct answer is: **Option 4**.&
